singleSourceOfTruthMap.canonical: Technical Architecture Governor spec (to be created)

Color.decisionRights: Approves HEX values, semantic mappings, gradient definitions, shadow definitions, interaction colors, expression mappings. Cannot change Soul-defined principles.

Typography.decisionRights: Approves font families (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, JetBrains Mono), token scales, line heights, letter spacing, case rules, AURA typography. Cannot change Soul-defined principles.

Photography.decisionRights: Approves official muses, lighting specs, composition system, retouching policy, domain-specific guidelines, asset metadata. Cannot change Soul-defined principles.

Iconography.decisionRights: No changes allowed to the 51 locked icons. Migration to the locked system is governed by the Icon Migration Plan.

Components.decisionRights: Approves component taxonomy, foundation tokens (spacing, radius, shadows, surfaces), component languages (card, button, etc.), component states, motion language, responsive language, accessibility language. Cannot change Soul-defined principles.

AudienceExpression.decisionRights: Approves expression resolution logic, audience service updates, new expression contexts (if any). Cannot change Soul-defined Women/Men/AURA expressions.

DataSchema.decisionRights: Approves database schema changes (tables, columns, indexes, constraints, seeds, migrations). Cannot change Soul-defined data principles.

AIModels.decisionRights: Approves new AI agents, models, RAG pipeline changes, embedding updates, evaluation metrics, orchestration workflows. Cannot change Soul-defined AI principles (quiet intelligence, human warmth).

Prompts.decisionRights: Approves prompt templates, prompt versions, prompt testing. Cannot change Soul-defined AI principles.

RAG.decisionRights: Approves RAG pipeline changes, chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, evaluation metrics. Cannot change Soul-defined AI principles.

QualityGates.decisionRights: Approves quality gate definitions, testing strategies, acceptance criteria, definition of done. Cannot change Soul-defined quality principles.

Security.decisionRights: Approves authentication methods, authorization rules, data protection measures, network security configurations, security headers, dependency scanning protocols, secrets management, compliance measures. Cannot change Soul-defined security principles.

Accessibility.decisionRights: Approves accessibility guidelines, contrast minimums, focus management rules, scaling factors, touch target sizes, screen reader label requirements, reduced motion settings, color blindness adaptations. Cannot change Soul-defined accessibility principles.

Performance.decisionRights: Approves performance budgets (startup time, frame rate, bundle size), latency metrics, optimization guidelines. Cannot change Soul-defined performance principles.

TechnicalArchitecture.decisionRights: Approves architecture layers, communication patterns, technology stack choices, infrastructure decisions, API contract changes. Cannot change Soul-defined architectural principles.

SOUL_vs_SPEC.resolutionRule: SOUL always wins. SPEC must be revised to align with SOUL.

SPEC_vs_TOKEN.resolutionRule: SPEC wins. TOKEN implementation must be updated to match SPEC.

TOKEN_vs_COMPONENT.resolutionRule: TOKEN wins. COMPONENT must use tokens as defined.

COMPONENT_vs_SCREEN.resolutionRule: COMPONENT wins. SCREEN must use components as defined.

SCREEN_vs_LEGACY.resolutionRule: SCREEN (new) wins over LEGACY. LEGACY must be migrated or deprecated.
SCREEN_vs_LEGACY.escalationPath: L4 Governor reviews and enforces migration plan.

LEGACY_vs_LEGACY.resolutionRule: The more recently updated LEGACY system wins, but both must be migrated to canonical.
LEGACY_vs_LEGACY.escalationPath: L1/L2 Governor reviews and enforces migration.

DuplicateAuthorities.resolutionRule: Canonical (as defined in Single Source of Truth Map) wins. Duplicates must be deprecated or mapped.
DuplicateAuthorities.escalationPath: L1 Governor reviews and enforces deprecation/mapping.

AI_vs_SOUL.resolutionRule: SOUL wins. AI implementation must be revised to align with SOUL.

Quality_vs_Implementation.resolutionRule: Quality wins. Implementation must meet quality gates.

Security_vs_Implementation.resolutionRule: Security wins. Implementation must meet security rules.

Accessibility_vs_Implementation.resolutionRule: Accessibility wins. Implementation must meet accessibility rules.

Performance_vs_Implementation.resolutionRule: Performance wins. Implementation must meet performance budgets.

TechnicalArchitecture_vs_Implementation.resolutionRule: Technical Architecture wins. Implementation must conform to architecture.
TechnicalArchitecture_vs_Implementation.escalationPath: Technical Architecture Governor reviews and enforces.

governanceRisks.description: Authorities making decisions without consulting higher levels or related domains.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Enforce escalation paths, require L1/L2 approval for L3/L4 changes.

governanceRisks.description: Teams continuing to use legacy systems due to familiarity or perceived effort.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Automated deprecation warnings, migration scripts, compliance checks in CI.

governanceRisks.description: Missing or incomplete specifications (e.g., Typography, Photography, Quality, etc.).
governanceRisks.mitigation: Prioritize specification completion in G1-B, use placeholders with clear ownership.

governanceRisks.description: Governance rules not enforced in practice, leading to drift.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Integrate validation gates into CI/CD, require governor sign-off for changes exceeding thresholds.

governanceRisks.description: Overuse of exception mechanism undermining governance.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Strict criteria for exceptions, require Director approval, log and review exceptions quarterly.

governanceRisks.description: Unclear ownership leading to conflicts or decisions falling through cracks.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Maintain and publish Authority Registry, update on changes, ensure every domain has a governor.

governanceRisks.description: Specifications too detailed or too abstract for implementation needs.
governanceRisks.mitigation: Regular reviews with implementation teams, adjust spec levels as needed.

recommendedG1BInputs: Complete specifications for all L1 domains (Typography, Photography, Quality, Technical Architecture, Accessibility, Performance, Security) based on Soul and G0 audit findings.
Finalize the Single Source of Truth mappings and deprecation plans for all legacy systems.
Define detailed validation gates for each L1 authority (what constitutes compliance, how to validate).
Create the exception registry template and exception handling process.
Define the promotion path for experimental work (L5) to become production (L4) after governance approval.
Establish the change classification process (how changes are classified as L0-L5 and who approves).
Define the tooling and automation needed to enforce governance (lint rules, automated tests, compliance checks).
Align all G0 audit recommendations with the authority model (e.g., token consolidation, icon migration, legacy theme migration).
